lines.text: On the third day, Esther stood in the inner court, and the king held out the gold scepter to her.
The king offered Esther up to half the kingdom, and she asked him and Haman to her banquet today.
While drinking wine, the king asked Esther her petition, and she invited him and Haman to come in three days.
Haman raged when Mordecai would not rise at the gate, and he told his friends he was not satisfied.
Zeresh and his friends told Haman to build a gallows seventy cubits high, and he had it constructed.
